definitions.gloss: sound truck; van fitted with loudspeakers for street campaigning
definitions.explanation: A vehicle equipped with loudspeakers used to broadcast political messages on the street. The word most often calls to mind the black vans of right-wing groups, but it also covers the campaign vans used by candidates during elections.

examples.japanese: {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: A sound truck is parked in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: As the election approaches, the candidates' sound trucks drive all over town.

notes:
Made up of ⟦{街頭|がいとう}→街頭：19431_gaitou⟧ (on the street) + ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧ (publicity) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: a sound truck drives around
- {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: the noise from a sound truck
- ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}: a right-wing sound truck
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦カー→カー：00130_kaa⟧: election campaign car — the neutral term used at election time

CULTURAL NOTE:
Black {街宣車|がいせんしゃ} playing military music and slogans at high volume are a familiar sight near stations and government offices in Japanese cities. Because of that association the word carries a faintly negative tone, so news coverage of ordinary campaigning usually prefers ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦カー→カー：00130_kaa⟧.
